rules_loaded.motion_use: Score simple robot tasks as walk -> reach -> open/close -> sit/stand -> multi-step kitchen or care assistance.

rules_loaded.rule: IK corrections must preserve temporal continuity; knee/ankle/hip jumps are worse than mild pose error.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Use bounded per-frame joint deltas and smooth correction weights across contact phases.

rules_loaded.rule: Factory manipulation tasks must map to valid MOST General Move / Hand Move sequences with TMU totals.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Encode pick/place as reach-grasp-move-position-release; compare indices to Sandin sequence method.

rules_loaded.rule: Rollout cycle time should approach MOST-derived standard time before L39/L40 promotion.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Use standard-time ratio as a curriculum gate alongside task success and collision safety.

rules_loaded.rule: Real robot deployment requires a restricted edge controller, emergency stop, speed/force limits, and simulator-to-hardware validation.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Convert learned behaviors into Raspberry Pi/ROS 2/microcontroller profiles only after offline replay and safety gates pass.

rules_loaded.rule: During stance or double support, projected CoM should remain within the support polygon plus a small visual tolerance.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Reject or correct frames where the character appears to tip despite planted feet.

rules_loaded.rule: Decompose each robot task rollout into the 18 therblig elements before scoring cycle efficiency.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Label reach/grasp/move/use phases on door, pick, and walk tasks; block promotion when coverage is low.

rules_loaded.rule: Many robots/environments should collect short rollouts in parallel, while only selected episodes are rendered for human review.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Train headless at scale, then export score, success/NG, collision, energy, and GIF/GLB evidence for dashboard inspection.

rules_loaded.rule: Apply ECRS: Eliminate search/select, Combine hold+position, Rearrange pre-position, Simplify tool use.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Suggest fixture layout, bin organization, and pre-positioning before RL fine-tuning.

rules_loaded.rule: A walking step reads more naturally when heel contact, flat support, and toe-off phases are distinguishable.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Add keyframe markers or foot roll constraints around contact transitions.

rules_loaded.rule: Root/CoM path should be smooth and coherent with step cadence; abrupt root speed changes break walking weight.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Low-pass smooth pelvis/root travel and keep stride distance consistent with footfall timing.

rules_loaded.rule: Swing foot should clear the ground enough to avoid visual scraping but not float excessively.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Clamp swing arc to model scale and terrain height.

rules_loaded.rule: Therblig counts, NVA ratio, and MOST sequence summary must export for WorkStudy AI review.
rules_loaded.motion_use: Emit JSON/Excel-compatible therblig timeline for human IE verification on port 7870.
